One thing worth knowing A life policy cannot be transferred. No agent, no broker and no other company can move it for you — if anyone suggests you move, what is being proposed is that you end this one and buy a new one, priced at your age now. Under the Insurance Act, whoever suggests it must discuss the advantages and the disadvantages with you first — so ask for it in writing. How the law protects you, in plain words →
